title: NS Client has no temp targets
body:
Any change in making a temporary target in AAPS 3.0.0.1 is not showing up in NSClient app 3.0.0.1
![IMG-20220220-WA0001(1)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34131445/154836152-86f1f399-ea61-42f1-a44b-f63c22338a07.jpg)
![Screenshot_20220220-190858765](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34131445/154836153-8b354656-4944-4a2f-98d4-04277bf91e9f.jpg)

comments.body: to be able look at the issue i need log from both and time of occurence

Temp target started at 11.03pm in AAPS
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8109367/AndroidAPS.log)

No temp target in NSClient at 11.03pm

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8109396/AndroidAPS.log)

I've observed the same issue. Temp targets are not sent from AndroidAPS 3.0.0.1 to NSClient 3.0.0.1.

It seems like it was working when I first installed both apps, but it stopped working shortly after.

Sending remote Temp targets from NSClient to AndroidAPS also stopped working at the same time.

I've rebooted both phones but to no avail.

Hi @timocm, would it be possible to know why you closed this ticket? I am still experiencing this issue.

Did you do anything to solve the problem?

Thanks.

Started to use Dexcom G6 (vs G5); did another update to AAPS 3.0.0.1 (I had
returned to 2.8.2 while using G5) and then noticed that temp targets were
going through.
